blocks.x: Company release from Dataq Software: Dataq Software launches its new digital platform. What shipped, why now, and what it means for active engagements.

This announcement — Dataq Software launches its new digital platform — lands on 2026-11-20. It reflects operating decisions made months ago: the platform work, the review cycles and the readiness checks all ran to the same standard we apply on client programs.

The engineering bet is explicit: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the Dataq Software launches its new digital platform estate, so your control owners can interrogate any number we publish.
The design principle here is simple: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default for the enterprise at scale, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.

items: the change covers the platforms and delivery motions named above; client-tenanted deployments adopt it through their normal release cadence, not automatically
effective from 2026-11-20, with the enablement material available to delivery teams immediately and client-facing documentation updating through the week
as with everything we ship, the change carries its own evidence: readiness checks, eval results and a rollback plan — available to clients on request

blocks.x: The practical next step sits with the delivery leads, who will walk each active client through impact and timing in the next scheduled review.
For media enquiries use press@dataqsoft.com — clients should raise anything impact-related with their delivery lead directly.
